summary.text: Antonio Hayes is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 40 in Baltimore City who has held the seat since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2019 and is vice chair of the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Antonio Hayes was born in Baltimore on December 9, 1977, and earned a B.S. in political science from Frostburg State University in 2000.

He was a legislative aide to Delegate Salima Siler Marriott from 2000 to 2002, director of legislative affairs for the Baltimore City Council president from 2003 to 2006, and assistant deputy mayor of administration from 2007 to 2010.
Hayes has worked for the Baltimore City Department of Social Services since 2010.
Hayes represented District 40 in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2015 to 2019.
He assumed office in the state Senate on January 9, 2019.
According to the General Assembly website, he is vice chair of the Finance Committee and a member of the Executive Nominations Committee.
